name: Notification Grouper
description: Group notifications by the app that sent them. Zero-config; generic names are grouped under that name, only senders that declare no name at all stay isolated per process.
_note: shell-version 仅声明 50（本扩展在此版本核对过 FDO 两个补丁点 NotifyAsync/_getSourceForPidAndName 与原生共享源行为，运行时验证完整）。48/49 源码级兼容但未运行时验证，不声明。
